info.title: HabitTrackerAPI Docs
info.description: HabitTrackerAPI OpenAPI documentation for the Laravel 13 REST API secured with Keycloak Bearer tokens.

get.description:
Returns a paginated list of activity logs for the specified habit.
Optionally filter by date to retrieve activities for a specific day.

post.description:
Records an activity entry against the specified habit and recalculates
the tracking record and settlement outcome for the activity's period.
post.summary: Log a new activity for a habit

get.description:
Returns the activity details along with the period total, target value,
and goal type for context.
get.summary: Get a single activity log entry

put.description:
Updates the activity and recalculates the tracking record and settlement
outcome for the affected period.

delete.description:
Soft-deletes the activity and recalculates the tracking record and settlement
outcome for the affected period.

post.description:
Creates a habit category with a name, icon, and color.
Categories are used to group habit templates.

put.description: Updates the name, icon, or color of the specified category.

delete.description:
Hides the category from all public listings by marking it inactive.
Does not delete the category or affect habits and templates already linked to it.
To restore it, update the category's active flag.

post.description: Creates a community on behalf of an admin. The admin becomes the owner.

put.description: Updates the name, description, or visibility of the specified community.

delete.description: Marks the community as archived, removing it from public listings.

patch.description:
Changes the membership status of a specific user within a community.
Use status=banned to permanently block the user from the community,
status=suspended for a temporary block, or status=active to reinstate them.

get.description:
Returns high-level platform metrics including total users, habits,
active streaks, and engagement stats for the specified date range.

Returns user registration trends, active user counts, and
deactivation stats for the specified date range.
get.summary: Get user growth and activity metrics (admin)

get.description:
Returns stats on habits created, templates used, communities formed,
and posts published for the specified date range.

Returns data on reported posts, moderated members, and suspended accounts
for the specified date range.

post.description:
Changes the moderation status of a post (e.g. approved, rejected, removed).
Use this to enforce community guidelines. Removed posts are hidden from all users
but not permanently deleted.

Creates a habit template under a category with suggested frequency,
target value, tips, and other defaults that users can adopt when creating habits.

put.description:
Updates the fields of the specified template. Changes apply to new habits
created from this template; existing habits are not affected.

delete.description:
Permanently removes the specified template. This does not affect habits
that were already created from this template.

patch.description:
Pass is_published=true to make the template visible to all users in template listings.
Pass is_published=false to hide it — useful for drafts or templates under review.
Does not affect habits already created from this template.

get.description:
Returns a paginated list of all users in the system.
Supports filtering by status, role, and search query.
Returns full profile details of the specified user including their preferences.

patch.description:
Pass status=inactive or status=suspended to block the user from logging in.
Pass status=active to restore access.
Both the local database record and the Keycloak account are updated together.
Use this to ban, suspend, or reinstate a user without deleting their data.
patch.summary: Disable or re-enable a user account (admin)

patch.description:
Pass role=admin to grant admin privileges, or role=user to revoke them.
An admin cannot change the role of another admin account.
patch.summary: Promote or demote a user's role (admin)

post.description:
Creates a new user in Keycloak and provisions a local account.
Optionally sends a verification email depending on server configuration.

Validates credentials against Keycloak and returns an access token,
refresh token, and the authenticated user's profile.
post.summary: Authenticate a user and issue tokens

post.description: Exchanges a valid refresh token for a new access token and refresh token pair.

Sends a Keycloak-generated password reset email to the provided address.
The optional redirect_uri specifies where Keycloak redirects the user after
completing the reset flow. It must be in the server's allowed redirect URI list.

message.const: If the account exists, a password reset email has been sent.

post.description:
This endpoint is intentionally disabled. Password resets must be initiated
via the reset request flow and completed through Keycloak's hosted UI.

get.description:
Returns the Keycloak authorization URL as JSON instead of redirecting.
Useful for API documentation tools and testing.
get.summary: Get the social provider redirect URL (for API testing)

instructions.const: Open the redirect_url in a browser to begin OAuth flow

get.description:
Generates and returns a Keycloak authorization URL for the given provider (e.g. google, facebook).
The client should redirect the user to this URL to begin the OAuth flow.
get.summary: Redirect to a social identity provider

get.description:
Exchanges the authorization code returned by Keycloak for tokens,
provisions or syncs the local user account, and returns the token payload.

post.description: Revokes the provided refresh token in Keycloak, ending the user's session.

Triggers Keycloak to send a verification email to the authenticated user's address.
The optional redirect_uri specifies where Keycloak redirects after verification.

message.const: If the account exists, a verification email has been sent.

get.description:
Returns a flat list of all published categories including their name, icon, and color.
Use this to populate category selection screens.

Returns all published habit templates belonging to the specified category.
Use this to show template options after the user selects a category.

Returns a paginated list of public communities. Supports search and filtering.
Does not require the user to be a member.

post.description: Creates a community owned by the authenticated user.

get.description:
Returns the details of the specified community including member count
and the current user's membership status.

post.description: Adds the authenticated user as a member of the specified community.
Removes the authenticated user from the specified community.

get.description:
Returns a paginated list of members in the specified community.
Only accessible to members of the community.

Returns an overview of the authenticated user's habit activity including
completion rates, active streaks, and progress for the specified date range.

Returns detailed statistics for the specified habit including completion history,
streak data, and progress toward the target for the given date range.
get.summary: Get stats for a specific habit

get.description:
Returns a day-by-day breakdown of habit completion status for the specified
date range, suitable for rendering a calendar heatmap view.

Returns a paginated list of habits belonging to the current user.
Each habit includes today's tracking status and current streak data.

post.description:
Creates a habit from scratch with all fields provided manually.
Fields such as title, category_id, frequency_type, and goal_type are required.

data.description: Return the enriched shape consistent with show()

post.description:
Pre-fills habit fields from the specified template. Only start_date is required;
all other fields are optional and can be used to override the template defaults.
post.summary: Create a habit from a template

data.description: Return the enriched shape consistent with show()

get.description:
Returns full details of the specified habit including today's tracking status
and streak information.

put.description:
Updates the specified habit's fields. Changes to frequency or target value
are recorded as timeline events.

delete.description:
Sets the habit status to archived and records an archive timeline event.
The habit is no longer active but its data is preserved.

patch.description:
Pass is_paused=true to pause the habit — it will stop appearing in today's tracking
and its status changes to paused. Pass is_paused=false to resume it and set it back to active.
Both actions are recorded as timeline events.
Sets the habit status to completed and records a completion timeline event.

post.description:
Accepts an image file (jpg, jpeg, png, webp, gif) up to 5MB.
The 'context' field determines the storage path:
  - avatar: for profile picture uploads
  - post:   for images attached to community posts

Returns the public URL to use in subsequent profile update or post create/update requests.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of notifications ordered by most recent first.
get.summary: List notifications for the authenticated user

get.description: Returns the number of unread notifications for the authenticated user.

patch.description: Sets read_at on all unread notifications for the authenticated user.
Sets the read_at timestamp on the specified notification.

get.description:
Returns a paginated list of posts within the specified community.
Only accessible to members of the community.

post.description:
Publishes a new post to the specified community.
The authenticated user must be a member of the community.
post.summary: Create a post in a community

get.description: Returns the full post details including like count and comment count.

put.description: Allows the post author to update the content of their post.

delete.description: Soft-deletes the specified post. Only the post author can delete their own post.

post.description: Adds a comment from the authenticated user to the specified post.
post.summary: Add a comment to a post

delete.description: Soft-deletes the specified comment. Only the comment author can delete their own comment.
delete.summary: Delete a comment from a post

post.description:
Adds or changes the authenticated user's reaction to the specified post.
Sending the same reaction type again removes it (toggle behavior).
Sending a different type replaces the existing reaction.
Returns the new reaction state and a summary of all reaction counts.

get.description:
Returns a paginated chronological log of events for the specified habit,
such as habit created, started, paused, frequency changed, and completed.

Returns a paginated list of period settlement records showing the expected target,
actual result, and outcome (completed, missed, partial) for each period.
get.summary: List settlement records for a habit

get.description:
Returns the settlement record for the specified habit and period date,
including the outcome and any manual adjustments.
get.summary: Get the settlement for a specific date

post.description:
Overrides the system-calculated outcome (completed/missed/partial) for a specific period.
Use this when the user wants to correct a result the system got wrong.
The original outcome and adjustment reason are stored for audit purposes.

get.description:
Returns a paginated list of published habit templates across all categories.
Supports filtering by category_id. Each template includes its associated category.

post.description:
Users can create their own templates for reuse across multiple habits.
User-created templates are private unless published by an admin.

get.description: Returns all templates created by the authenticated user (personal templates).
get.summary: List the authenticated user's own templates

get.description:
Returns full details of the specified published template including
suggested frequency, target value, tips, and associated category.

put.description: Users can edit templates they created. Admins can edit any template.

patch.description: Users can edit templates they created. Admins can edit any template.

delete.description: Users can delete templates they created. Does not affect habits already created from it.

get.description:
Returns all of the authenticated user's habits with their tracking status for today,
giving a quick overview of what's pending and what's been completed.

Returns a paginated list of daily or weekly tracking records for the specified habit,
showing the status (pending, completed, missed) and recorded value for each period.
get.summary: List tracking records for a habit

post.description:
Creates a tracking record for a specific period. Useful for logging
completion of binary habits or backdating records.

patch.description: Updates the status or recorded value of an existing tracking record for the specified period.

get.description:
Returns the current and longest streak for the specified habit,
along with the last completed date.
get.summary: Get the streak for a habit

get.description: Returns the current user's profile data including their preferences.

put.description: Allows the user to update their username, bio, and avatar URL.

delete.description:
Marks your account as deleted and blocks all future logins by disabling
your Keycloak account. This cannot be undone by the user — only an admin
can restore access by setting your status back to active.

get.description: Returns the current and longest streak based on completing ALL active habits each day.
get.summary: Get the authenticated user's overall streak

get.description:
Returns notification settings, timezone, language, and reminder time.
Creates default preferences if none exist yet.

put.description: Allows updating notification settings, timezone, language, and reminder time.

Flutter should call this endpoint after login and whenever the FCM token
is refreshed. The token is used to send push notifications (reminders and
missed habit alerts) to this device.
put.summary: Register or update the device FCM token

get.description: Returns a paginated list of users who follow you.
Returns a paginated list of users you are currently following.
get.summary: List users the authenticated user is following

post.description:
Start following the specified user. If you are already following them,
this returns the existing follow record without creating a duplicate.
You cannot follow yourself.

delete.description: Stop following the specified user. If you are not following them, this does nothing.

get.description:
Returns a paginated list of users who follow the specified user.
Accessible for any user profile.

Returns a paginated list of users that the specified user follows.
Accessible for any user profile.
get.summary: List users that a user is following

get.description:
Returns the follower count, following count, and whether the authenticated
user is currently following the specified user.
get.summary: Get follow stats for a user

bearerAuth.description: JWT Bearer token issued by Keycloak.

category_id.description: category_id is required when not using a template (template carries its own category)

title.description: These fields are pre-filled from the template; user may override them

start_date.description: start_date is always required — user must explicitly choose when to start

errors.description: A detailed description of each field that failed validation.
